cmdline:
bash -c 
set +e
bridge_exe="$1"; bridge_config="$2"; bridge_core_ip="$3"; bridge_pid_file="$4"; bridge_status_file="$5"
"$bridge_exe" --ros-args --params-file "$bridge_config" -p core_ip:="$bridge_core_ip" &
bridge_pid="$!"
printf "%s\n" "$bridge_pid" >"$bridge_pid_file.tmp"
mv "$bridge_pid_file.tmp" "$bridge_pid_file"
wait "$bridge_pid"
bridge_rc="$?"
printf "%s\n" "$bridge_rc" >"$bridge_status_file.tmp"
mv "$bridge_status_file.tmp" "$bridge_status_file"
exit "$bridge_rc"
